resolutions.phrase: The intake rota stays fortnightly, as agreed on 1 October, but the overlap call at each hand-off grows from fifteen to thirty minutes.

referents.why: The 1 October statement set a fortnightly rota with a fifteen-minute overlap call. This keeps the fortnightly cadence but replaces the overlap length with thirty minutes.

resolutions.why: 'As agreed on 1 October' and the fifteen-minute overlap converge on the single rota statement from the 2026-10-01 team call. The pantry rule and start-date statements are not touched.

resolutions.phrase: Fifteen minutes covered the open cases but not the ones that arrived during the hand-off week.

referents.why: Gives the reasoning for changing the fifteen-minute overlap call set on 1 October. It adds detail and does not itself replace the position.
